name: EXM_CC_TRXN_DETAILS
description: This table contains Level 3 details of corporate card transactions.

columns.name: CC_TRXN_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Application generated unique identifier of a detail transaction.

columns.name: CREDIT_CARD_TRXN_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the parent corporate card transaction of the detail transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount as charged by the merchant in the currency of the transaction.

columns.name: BILLED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount billed to the corporate card by the corporate card issuer.

columns.name: EXT_FOLIO_TYPE
columns.description: Code that the merchant uses to identify the product or service purchased in this transaction.

columns.name: FOLIO_TYPE
columns.description: Corporate card expense types that are assigned to the transaction by the upload process.

columns.name: ITEM_SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Sequence number of an item in a line item detail transaction.

columns.name: ITEM_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the item purchased in this transaction.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Transaction date of item for detailed transaction.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
